Subject: Praxis Health: internal pre-handoff notes (attachments)

Team — following up with a compact list of technical/contractual constraints pulled from the initial discovery:
- Customer tech stack: AWS (us-east-1), internal EHR on-prem; will use SFTP to push batches.
- Expected traffic: steady-state ~500k tokens/day first 60 days rising to ~1.8M tokens/day after month 3.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 300ms for single-turn queries; embeddings can be background batched.
- Security: US-only logging, DPA required, SOC2 evidence requested (they also asked for KMS integration notes).
- Billing: PS + monthly usage; procurement expects invoice net 30.

Attachments: Praxis-Integration-Appendix.docx

Notes on risk: If we cannot guarantee the logging retention policy and KMS interaction within the schedule, procurement may push a 30–45 day delay. They will test model outputs against a curated prompt set during staging (QA acceptance).

I'll hand off the external thread once owners are confirmed.
Grace

Subject: Praxis Health — Implementation owner assignment & tentative milestones

Thanks Grace / Liam / Maya — looping in schedule and owners below.

Owners (confirmed):
- CS Lead: Karthik Iyer (primary contact for acceptance and rollout)
- Implementation Engineer: Tessa Morgan (technical runbooks, scripts, staging)
- Solutions Engineer (infra/KMS): Ben Carter (KMS and network posture)

Tentative timeline (4-week onboarding sprint):
Week 0 (Apr 4) — Kickoff / scoping workshop (1.5h): agree on acceptance tests, data handoff, and roles. Deliverable: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with owners and dates.
Week 1 — Staging setup: provision dedicated environment (if approved), KMS proof-of-concept, sample dataset ingestion.
Week 2 — Integration: SFTP flows, initial embedding pipelines, smoke tests.
Week 3 — Validation & acceptance: run curated prompt evaluation, fix regressions, finalize monitoring / alerting.
Go-live target: Apr 20 (contingent on SOW + DPA sign-off by procurement; slack buffer 1 week).

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Ingestion pipeline can process sample dataset (<24h).
- Embedding accuracy: similarity recall > 90% on provided test set.
- Latency: 95p < 350ms for interactive queries during acceptance window.
- Security: DPA in place and KMS integration demoed; logs retention policy documented.

Open questions for Praxis (please ask in the kickoff):
1) Will Praxis require a dedicated VPC peering or are standard public endpoints acceptable?
2) Exact token volume estimates for peak month 1 vs month 3.
3) Contact for procurement legal and the person who will sign DocuSign.

On the SOW / procurement timeline: Grace — when you upload the SOW to DocuSign, please tag HS-7841 and mark the envelope for internal review; I'll prepare the MAP and a short runbook to attach.

On it — I'll schedule the Apr 4 kickoff and circulate a draft MAP by Mar 17.
Karthik
